title: the_gym_teacher_recorded_over_it
display_title: My PE teacher taped over my final run — with someone else's name on it
share_line: Send this to anyone whose coach ever took credit for their work.
beats: My PE teacher recorded my final parkour run for the school archive — and it got uploaded under a different student's name.
I'm 15. This was for a state athletics scholarship review, not some class assignment.
I'd been filming that course for six weeks, memorizing every ledge, every gap, every landing.
The day of my clean run, Mr. Halloway said the camera 'glitched' and asked me to run it again tomorrow.
Tomorrow never came — two days later the video was already online, credited to a kid who'd quit the team in October.
I emailed the district asking why my name wasn't on my own footage, and I got a one-line reply: 'The roster has been finalized.'
I still have the chalk mark I left on the wall to test the camera angle — it's still there, in the corner of his video.
Was I wrong to email the state board directly, or should I have just let it go?
